title: 30L Semi Enclosed Cat Litter Box With Footboard And Scoop Stainless Steel Litter Box Plastic Walkway
body_html: 1、Structure Design: This cat litter box features stair step design, which is friendly to weak or short legged cats, with filter cat litter footboard, prevent dirtying the surrounding environment 2、Stainless Steel Box: Using stainless steel cat litter box, which is sturdy, rustproof, and long lasting. Featuring a non stick bottom, will not absorb odor, convenient for cleanup and maintenance 3、30L Capacity: This cat litter box has a large capacity of 30L, can hold up more cat litter, providing plenty of space for your cat to move around, also making it suitable for cats of all sizes 4、Semi Enclosed and High Side: This cat litter box has a semi enclosed and high sided design, preventing leakage of cat urine and protecting the cat privacy, which is convenient and practical 5、Safe and Practical: With fine workmanship, this stainless steel cat litter box has safe rolled edges, and glossy appearance, not harmful to your pet feet, so you can use it with confidenceItem Type: Cat Litter BoxMaterial: Stainless Steel, PlasticOverall Size: Approx. 60 x 40 x 15cm / 23.6 x 15.7 x 5.9in1 x Cat Litter Box1 x Scoop1 x Container
